collection.title: Audi A2 2002 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2002 to 2005 version of the Audi A2 Hatchback which requires a 30" wiper blade. This model uses the Side Pin type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
